Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one production pixel-art RUN animation sprite strip for a top-down adventure game.
Image 1 is the exact approved character design and proportions, facing right. Preserve his large shaggy dark-brown head, tiny face, rust scarf, olive jacket, cream shirt, dark brown backpack, SHORT CHUNKY trousers and wide boots. Head is roughly half of standing character height. Legs must remain short and substantial, not long or thin. Image 2 is the user's Wildroot world mockup: mood and adventurer character context only. Do not reproduce UI, environment, or increase detail.
Deliver ONE evenly spaced strip: exactly SIX equal square cells in ONE horizontal row, transparent background, no captions. Every cell shows the SAME character facing RIGHT at the SAME scale. Keep the head shape and torso volume consistent. Pixel-art with blocky visible square pixels designed for eventual 64x64 cells (character about42px tall). Exactly six opaque color families: near-black #252323, brown #574236, olive #68734b, cream #e6cf9a, skin #d79b5b, rust #ad5739. No gradients or dithering.
Redraw an appealing hand-animated chibi run, not a hinged stick-figure rig. Torso leans slightly forward, bent elbows pump opposite the legs, the scarf and backpack follow subtly. Readable negative space between arms and torso and between feet. Same chunky hand and boot sizes in all six cells. The brown near leg and dark far leg retain their own color throughout.
Sequential poses left to right:
1 near brown foot reaches forward to contact, far dark leg folded back; near arm back, far arm forward.
2 weight/compression over near brown supporting leg, far dark knee travels forward; the pelvis settles slightly.
3 airborne passing/recoil, near brown foot kicks backward, far dark knee leads forward, bent arms counter-swing; preserve boot size.
4 far dark foot reaches forward to contact, near brown leg folded back; opposite arms.
5 weight/compression over far dark supporting leg, near brown knee travels forward.
6 airborne passing/recoil, far dark foot kicks backward, near brown knee leads forward, leads smoothly back to pose1.
The contact poses must be clear opposites; both physical legs complete the full stride. Avoid march/high-knee exercise, skating, identical poses, arm stubs, flailing, shrinking limbs, tall anatomy, redesigning clothes, detached hands or boots, highlights beyond six-color palette.
armCorrection:
Edit the six-frame right-facing pixel-art run strip in Image1. Image2 is the original approved character for identity. Keep ALL six cells, exact character scale, short chunky legs, clothes, head and backpack. Main correction: the arm cycle is currently WRONG: the visible near arm remains behind the torso and the far arm remains in front in every frame. REDRAW THE ARMS to complete an alternating run counter-swing. Do not change leg poses or merely swap arm colors.
Define NEAR ARM = arm on the viewer's side, with the LIGHT ORANGE HAND #d79b5b. FAR ARM = the other arm, with the DARK BROWN HAND #574236. These colors identify physical arms and NEVER switch across frames. The near sleeve is olive. Both hands and forearms keep their size. Keep bent elbows.
Exactly six sequential cells, all facing RIGHT:
Frame1: LIGHT hand clearly BEHIND the torso to screen LEFT; DARK hand clearly AHEAD to screen RIGHT.
Frame2: both arms pass towards center, light hand moves rightwards towards chest.
Frame3: LIGHT hand visibly AHEAD of the chest to screen RIGHT, close to chin height; DARK hand behind, screen LEFT, partly occluded by body/backpack.
Frame4: LIGHT hand fully AHEAD of chest to screen RIGHT, protruding beyond the right edge of the torso; DARK hand fully BEHIND the torso, screen LEFT. This is the opposite arm pose to frame1.
Frame5: both arms pass back through center.
Frame6: LIGHT hand goes BEHIND torso to screen LEFT; DARK hand returns AHEAD, screen RIGHT.
Frames1 and4 MUST visibly show opposite colored hands leading. Do not keep the same arm in front in every cell. In frames3 and4 remove the stationary hand currently sticking out in front and replace it with the light hand attached naturally to the near sleeve. Show the dark far hand extending behind the backpack at these frames. Same outline thickness, blocky square-pixel style, existing six color families. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no extra cells.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel-art SIX-frame run strip for a top-down chibi adventurer. Image1 is the approved exact character design and short proportions. Image2 is our newly redrawn side run for clothing volume/style only. Transparent background; exactly six equal square cells, one horizontal row, no text. Preserve large shaggy brown head (half the character height), rust scarf, olive jacket, cream shirt, short chunky brown trousers, wide chunky boots and dark backpack. Designed for eventual64x64 cells, character42px high. Six colors only: #252323 #574236 #68734b #e6cf9a #d79b5b #ad5739. No gradients/dithering or extra detail.
An appealing hand-drawn run with contact, compression, flight, opposite contact, opposite compression, opposite flight. Arms must visibly counter-swing across a COMPLETE cycle, NOT stay fixed. Bent elbows and substantial wrists/hands. Every hand and boot keeps its volume. Head shape and body scale consistent. Avoid long/thin legs, mannequin joints, frozen arms, marching, extreme knee lifts, flailing and camera rotation.
All six poses face DOWN towards the viewer at the same top-down camera angle as Image1. Backpack is mostly behind the shoulders.
1 screen-left foot reaches down/forward, screen-right leg kicks back/up; LEFT HAND swings back/up closer to shoulder, RIGHT HAND swings forward/down near waist.
2 compress over screen-left supporting foot, both arms passing through middle.
3 flight, screen-left foot recoils, screen-right knee leads; LEFT HAND now forward/down, RIGHT HAND back/up.
4 screen-right foot reaches down/forward, screen-left leg recoils; LEFT HAND fully forward/down, RIGHT HAND fully back/up (OPPOSITE to frame1).
5 compress over right supporting foot, arms cross middle.
6 flight, left knee leads again; left hand back/up, right hand forward/down. Torso has subtle one-pixel bounce at target scale. Keep the original face and hair silhouette and original jacket.
